_comment: IRC/MoRTH road marking rules. IMPORTANT: Do NOT invent dimensions. All entries carry verification_required=true. Engineers must verify against the current official IRC:35-2015, MoRTH Specification for Road and Bridge Works (latest edition), and sanctioned drawings.
_warning: Dimensions listed here are indicative and for reference only. Always verify against the current official edition and project-specific sanction.

rules.applicability_notes: A broken white centre line is generally required on undivided two-lane or multi-lane urban roads. Refer IRC:35-2015 for exact dash/gap pattern applicable to the road type and speed.
rules.engineering_note: Verify the applicable dash length, gap length, and line width against Table 1 / relevant clause of IRC:35-2015 (latest amendment) and the sanctioned road layout.

rules.applicability_notes: Lane dividing lines are required where carriageway is marked for multiple lanes. The line type (broken/solid) depends on the operational requirement.
rules.engineering_note: Verify lane width, line width, dash/gap dimensions, and colour (white) against IRC:35-2015 and the sanctioned drawing.

rules.applicability_notes: A continuous white edge line is generally provided on the nearside edge of the carriageway on arterial roads. Check applicability for the specific road cross-section.
rules.engineering_note: Verify edge line width, offset from carriageway edge, and continuity requirements against IRC:35-2015 and sanctioned drawings.

rules.applicability_notes: Stop lines are required at signalised and un-signalised intersections per IRC:35-2015 and IRC:93.
rules.engineering_note: Verify stop line width, setback from the give-way/signal line, and colour against the applicable standard and sanctioned intersection layout.
rules.source_document: IRC:35-2015 — Guidelines for Road Markings; IRC:93

rules.applicability_notes: Zebra crossings or ladder markings are required at designated pedestrian crossing locations per IRC:35-2015.
rules.engineering_note: Verify number of stripes, stripe width, gap, total width, and offset from stop line against IRC:35-2015 and the sanctioned layout.

rules.applicability_notes: MoRTH Specifications for Road and Bridge Works, Section 803 specifies materials, retroreflectivity requirements, and application standards for road markings on National Highways and other central/state roads.
rules.engineering_note: Verify material specification (thermoplastic / paint / cold-plastic), retroreflectivity class, and application conditions against the current MoRTH Section 803 edition and the project specification.
rules.source_document: MoRTH Specifications for Road and Bridge Works — Section 803 (latest edition)

rules.applicability_notes: Road markings on national highways are generally required to meet minimum retroreflectivity levels. Retroreflectivity assessment is NOT possible through visual/camera inspection alone.
rules.engineering_note: Retroreflectivity must be measured by a certified retroreflectometer in the field. Camera-based assessment can indicate visibility only — not retroreflectivity compliance.
rules.source_document: MoRTH Specifications for Road and Bridge Works — Section 803 (latest edition)
